claims.claim: Powell reported record Q3 FY2026 orders of $934M, a 3.0x book-to-bill ratio, and $2.4B backlog, up 69% year over year.

Three mega-orders included a data-center project above $400M plus LNG and petrochemical awards, indicating power-distribution demand is broadening across AI infrastructure and industrial energy projects.

risks.risk: Large project awards create timing, concentration and execution risk; backlog is not equivalent to realized revenue.

unknowns.unknown: Customer identity and margin profile of the >$400M data-center order are not disclosed here.

claims.claim: Q3 FY2026 revenue rose 9% to $312M while gross margin held at 30.6% and net income rose 8% to $52.2M, showing current execution remained profitable as bookings accelerated.
The key execution test is converting the record $2.4B backlog through planned capacity expansion without margin degradation or project slippage.

risks.risk: Project-based revenue can be lumpy and backlog can be delayed, modified or cancelled.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental capacity utilization and gross margin on the newest mega-orders remain unknown.
